name: avalon-functions
description: Authoritative game server for Avalon online play

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test lib/test/rules.test.js lib/test/discussion.test.js lib/test/expansions.test.js lib/test/voice_ice.test.js
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project avalon-shadow-council "node --test lib/test/online.test.js"
scripts.test:cloud: npm run build && node -e "process.env.AVALON_TARGET='cloud'; require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'lib/test/online.test.js'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env})"
